slug: 2018-06-06 Equatorial Guinea and Cameroon are now more connected - AFR-IX telecom

facts.fact: AFR-IX (2018-06-06) states Ceiba-2, a 400 km cable linking Malabo, Bata and Kribi (Cameroon), was inaugurated on 4 June 2018 as the first direct international fibre link, alongside the ACE cable: two routes in service.
